SELECT fiscal_period, MIN(calendar_date) s, MAX(calendar_date) e, COUNT(*) n, MIN(fiscal_week) w1, MAX(fiscal_week) w2
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT status, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) dn, MIN(order_ts_utc), MAX(order_ts_utc), SUM(CASE WHEN dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nodisp
FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2024-11-15' AND order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01' GROUP BY 1

WITH wd AS (
 SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) dd
 FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
l AS (
 SELECT f.*, s.store_id, p.category, wd.dd, d.fiscal_period
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=wd.dd
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6)
SELECT store_id, category='ZZ Test' test, fiscal_period, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dsl, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) drl,
 SUM(net_amount) net, SUM(gross_amount) gross, SUM(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)) calc,
 SUM(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount-net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mism,
 MIN(etl_loaded_at), MAX(etl_loaded_at), SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff
FROM l GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AS after_sep1, COUNT(*) n, MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx, SUM(f.gross_amount) g
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-11-10'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3,2

SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, (w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL) has_order, w.status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(f.gross_amount) g
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-20' AND DATE '2024-10-30' AND (s.store_id=900 OR f.channel_code='WB' OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter AS quarter, d.fiscal_period AS period,
       SUM(f.gross_amount) AS web_sales_incl_vat_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS test_gross_excluded
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id = 900
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS period,
       SUM(f.gross_amount) AS web_sales_incl_vat_eur
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2
